title: Dissection and Immunohistochemistry of Mouse Vagal Ganglia
author: Thomas Taylor-Clark
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.w6cfhaw
materials: Tissue were incubated with primary antibody (1:150, goat anti-VR1, SC-12498, Santa Cruz) diluted in blocking buffer overnight at 4 °C

Secondary antibody (1:300, Alexa flour 647 Chicken anti-goat, A21469, Invitrogen) was diluted in the 1% bovine serum albumin/5% normal donkey serum/0.2% PBST and tissue were incubated with it for 1 hour at room temperature

steps.title: Euthanize mice
steps.instruction: Euthanize 6‑ to 8‑week‑old male mice by CO₂ inhalation.

steps.title: Perfuse with PBS then PFA
steps.instruction: Transcardially perfuse each mouse first with phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS) to clear blood, followed immediately by 3.7 % formaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.

steps.title: Dissect and fix ganglia
steps.instruction: Harvest both jugular and nodose vagal ganglia and fix them in 3.7 % PFA for 2 hours on ice.

substeps.instruction: Fix in 3.7 % PFA, 2 h on ice

steps.title: Cryoprotect in sucrose
steps.instruction: Transfer the fixed ganglia to 18 % sucrose solution and incubate overnight at 4 °C.

steps.title: Embed in OCT and freeze
steps.instruction: Mount the sucrose‑treated ganglia in optimal cutting temperature (OCT) compound and freeze the blocks.

steps.title: Section tissue onto slides
steps.instruction: Cut the frozen tissue at 20 µm thickness and collect sections onto Superfrost Plus microscopy slides.

steps.title: Wash sections with PBS
steps.instruction: Wash the sections three times with PBS, each wash lasting 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Block non‑specific binding
steps.instruction: Incubate sections in blocking buffer containing 1 % bovine serum albumin, 10 % normal donkey serum, and 0.3 % Triton X‑100 in PBS for 45 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash sections with PBST
steps.instruction: Wash the blocked sections three times with 0.2 % Tween‑20 in PBS (PBST), each wash for 10 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Cover‑slip and dry
steps.instruction: Apply DPX mounting medium, cover‑slip the slides for imaging, and let them dry in the dark overnight.
